title: SatMag Sono CD
overview:
Sono CD Vol. 1 is a Sega Saturn trial version CD-ROM that came as a special supplement with an extra issue of Weekly Sega Saturn Magazine.

The disc gathers previews of upcoming Saturn software, with featured titles including Burning Rangers, Mobile Suit Gundam: Giren no Yabou, Riven: The Sequel to Myst, Shiroki Majo: Mouhitotsu no Eiyuu Densetsu, Kunoichi Torimonochou and Dezaemon 2.
